sections.title: A matrix moves space
beats: A linear transformation stretches, rotates or shears space. Grid lines stay straight and evenly spaced.
You only need to know where î and ĵ land.
Write those landing spots as columns. That grid of numbers is the matrix.
sections.sayback: Why do just two landing spots describe the whole move?

sections.title: Matrix × vector
beats: To move [x, y]: take x of column 1 plus y of column 2.
sections.sayback: Do one by hand and explain each step.
sections.tieback: Neural nets: each layer is a matrix times a vector, then an activation.
